response.changelog:
RetroOS v23: Steam on Home.
- New: a Steam folder on Home, powered by DroidDeck. It lists the Steam games you have installed in DroidDeck and launches them straight from Home. When a game exits, you're back on Home.
- First time: opening the Steam folder runs DroidDeck's one-time setup and Steam sign-in. After that, the folder opens straight to your games.
- DroidDeck is included and installed automatically. It's a normal app you can update or remove.
- New All Apps icon in the dock: a 3x3 dot grid with the centre dot in your accent color.
- Note: this release has only been tested on the emulator so far. Real-hardware results to follow.

RetroOS v21: the first over-the-air update.
- New: Settings > System > System updates. Check for updates, download with progress and pause/resume (Wi-Fi only if you like), automatic checksum and signature verification, then install in the background and restart when you're ready. It also checks once a day and notifies you.
- The stock LineageOS Updater is gone. Updates now live in RetroOS Settings.
- Controller fix in Settings: after you touch the screen, the first A press no longer hits Back. It brings the highlight back to the page's first item, and the next A selects it.
- Recent highlights (v20): warm PSP-style sounds, rounded icons, the charging bolt and consistent pop-in/out animations.
- Note: this release has only been tested on the emulator so far. Real-hardware results to follow.
